subject: Hosted API capacity amplification & tier profile change
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@brightgrid.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@brightgrid.com
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity request — short-term commit increase and rate band change

Hi Laura,

Quick note from BrightGrid — our Q1 usage spiked because of a cross-region rollout and our current hosted commit is hitting throttles. We need to increase our monthly committed tokens and move up one usage tier for the next two quarters. Key asks: a) increase monthly commit from 3M -> 6M tokens, b) adjust rate-limit from 400rps to 800rps for our production route, and c) short-term burst window for peak traffic through end of June.

Attached is our Q1 usage export and a traffic heatmap. Can Redwood expedite a pricing amendment and a plan for faster activation? Procurement copied for contract steps.

Attachments:
- BrightGrid_Q1_usage.csv (csv)
- traffic_heatmap_apr2027.png (image)

Thanks,
Emma Li
Director, Engineering
BrightGrid


From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@brightgrid.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity request — short-term commit increase and rate band change

Emma — thanks for the heads up and the exports. We can support the expansion but need to align on pricing, activation timeline, and a small amendment to the hosted agreement for the increased commit and burst rules. I looped in Ben (pricing) and Marcus (ops) to validate throughput/path changes; Aditya for contract coordination.

Quick plan:
- Ben to confirm tier pricing and prorated billing for Apr–Jun.
- Marcus to confirm feasibility of moving BrightGrid to the 800rps route and any infra lead time.
- Legal/Aditya to prepare an amendment (short form) and a DocuSign link.

If that timeline works, I’ll target activation by 2027-04-08 with billing changes effective 2027-04-01 (prorated).

Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity request — short-term commit increase and rate band change

Laura — sounds straightforward. Pricing notes below (internal):

- Current commit: 3,000,000 tokens/mo at $0.018/token
- Proposed commit: 6,000,000 tokens/mo new price band $0.015/token (volume break)
- Prorate: bill monthly, prorated from Apr 1 — credit the unused portion of current month at existing rate, apply new band for remainder.
- Burst window: allow 2x burst for 90 days with surge surcharge of 15% over unit price for tokens consumed above committed monthly cap during burst windows.
- SLA note: upgrade to 800rps requires a quick config change; recommend a 24–48 hour maintenance window and test traffic for 2 hours post-migration.

I’m attaching a sample amendment template (internal) and will work with Aditya on language for DocuSign. Marcus — confirm if any infra reservation is needed for the route bump.

Ben
Director, Revenue Operations
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity request — short-term commit increase and rate band change

Ben/Laura — operationally feasible. Notes:
- Can enable the 800rps route for BrightGrid by 2027-04-08 09:00 PDT if we reserve two dedicated slots on the serving pool for the first 30 days. That requires a 14% uplift to our GPU pool allocation cost (internal).
- Recommend enabling KV-prefix caching for their high-QPS endpoints — will reduce cost and lower latency during bursts.
- Need BrightGrid to run a 15-min smoke test after cutover and provide a CNA for change window.

I’ll coordinate with infra to prepare the slots; share the doc link and I’ll approve the change.

— Marcus
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@brightgrid.com>, procure@brightgrid.com
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API capacity amendment & activation plan — BrightGrid

Emma / Procurement —

Following internal review, attached is the proposed short-form amendment and the activation plan. Summary of changes:
- Monthly committed tokens: increase 3,000,000 -> 6,000,000 (effective 2027-04-01; billing prorated)
- Unit price: $0.015/token (volume band applied)
- Burst policy: 2x burst allowance through 2027-06-30; tokens above monthly cap charged at 1.15x unit price
- Rate limits: production route increased to 800rps; 24–48 hour maintenance window anticipated for cutover on 2027-04-08; 15-min smoke test post-cutover
- Operational add-ons: dedicate two serving slots for 30 days (internal infra uplift)

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/abc123
Attachments: Proposed_Tier_Change_20270404.pdf (pdf)

Action items for BrightGrid:
1) Sign amendment via DocuSign by 2027-04-06 EOD to meet targeted activation.
2) Confirm a 2-hour test window during business hours on 2027-04-08.
3) Share a contact for the smoke test and a CNA for the change.

If you prefer a revised billing effective date (e.g., start of May) instead of backdating to Apr 1, flag that and we’ll recalc the prorate.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193
From: Emma Li <emma.li@brightgrid.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, procure@brightgrid.com
Cc: CloudMarkets Sales <sales@cloudmarkets.io>
Date: 2027-04-07T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity amendment & activation plan — BrightGrid

Laura — confirmed and signed. We completed signatures on the DocuSign link and uploaded the signed amendment (Signed_MA_Amendment.docusign). Procurement approves the prorated Apr billing.

Requests:
- Please proceed with the activation on 2027-04-08 as proposed.
- Marcus — will send the smoke-test contact (Sagar Patel) and target 10:30 AM PDT test window.
- Can Redwood enable an emergency rollback plan in case the burst surcharge is unexpectedly high during the first 48 hours? We want an agreed fallback to the original 3M cap while issues are triaged.

Attachments: BrightGrid_Q1_usage.csv (csv)

Emma Li
Director, Engineering
BrightGrid
